opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants

amount.raw: Our grants cover the cost of tuition fees, up to £1,820 per year for a full-time degree course.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals from low-income households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland (or have a substantial recent connection to Scotland), are entitled to remain indefinitely in the UK (or hold Limited Leave to Remain for the course duration, or are an asylum seeker), are not eligible for government tuition fee funding, and are enrolled on (or have an unconditional offer for) an undergraduate degree course at an eligible Scottish institution. Household income thresholds apply (e.g. £30,000 single, no children).
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to cover tuition fees (up to £1,820 per year) for undergraduate students from low-income households in Scotland who are ineligible for tuition fee support from the Scottish Government. Supports students enrolled on undergraduate degree courses at eligible Scottish higher education institutions, including those returning to study and some second-degree students in skills-shortage subject areas.
